s1.syndrome_frame: Acute pruritic skin eruption with vesicles and erythema following sun exposure
salient_findings: Erythema and helical thickening with numerous small blisters on ears
Vesicles at the upper and lower vermillion border
key_facts: 13-year-old boy presented with skin eruption
Eruption appeared 24 hours after intensive sun exposure
Patient reported malaise and headache 2 weeks before presentation
No history of photosensitivity
No use of topical or systemic photosensitizers
Laboratory tests showed detectable serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies
PVB19 DNA found in lesional skin biopsy specimen
Standard phototesting with UV-A and UV-B was unremarkable
Erythematous papules and crusts located on cheeks, neck, and lower arms

shortlist.label: Parvovirus B19-associated erythema
shortlist.why_kept: Detectable serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies and PVB19 DNA found in lesional skin biopsy specimen

shortlist.label: Polymorphic light eruption
shortlist.why_kept: Acute pruritic skin eruption with vesicles and erythema following sun exposure

shortlist.label: Erythema multiforme
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of erythematous papules, crusts, and vesicles on sun-exposed areas

shortlist.label: Hydroa vacciniforme
shortlist.why_kept: Similar presentation of vesicles and erythema on sun-exposed areas

shortlist.label: Phototoxic reaction
shortlist.why_kept: Onset of skin eruption 24 hours after intensive sun exposure

raw.rationale: Presence of PVB19 DNA in lesional skin biopsy specimen and detectable serum parvovirus B19 IgM and IgG antibodies

rejected.label: Erythema multiforme
rejected.why: While a possible diagnosis, the presence of PVB19 DNA and antibodies points towards a more specific subtype

rejected.label: Polymorphic light eruption
rejected.why: No clear indication of a light eruption that matches the patient's symptoms and test results

rejected.label: Hydroa vacciniforme
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and test results do not align with this condition, which typically involves more severe blistering and scarring

rejected.label: Phototoxic reaction
rejected.why: No evidence of photosensitizer use or typical phototoxic reaction symptoms
